important_caveat: ALL metrics are computed on SYNTHETIC FIXTURE DATA (2-16 samples). Real datasets (Food101, Nutrition5k, ECUSTFD, UEC256) are absent from data/raw/. These metrics reflect only whether the pipeline code is correct, NOT real-world ML performance.

detection.data_source: Synthetic fixture (YOLO predictions vs fixture bboxes)
detection.notes: Using pretrained YOLOv8n (MS-COCO 80-class). Food-class blacklist filter now active.

segmentation.notes: FoodUNet trained on 2 synthetic fixture images. All-zero masks on real images.

classification.notes: Classifier trained on 8 fixture samples (4 classes). Not representative of Food101 101-class performance.

portion_mass.notes: Mass regressor trained on 4 fixture samples. Plausibility guard now added (falls back to vol*density if pred outside [10,2000]g).

nutrition.notes: MultiNutrientModel trained on 4 fixture samples. Mean-predicted near zero (untrained backbone).
